Subject: Supportive correction plan for Rafael Mendes — initial alignment

Team —

I want to align on a short, structured plan to support Rafael over the next 6 weeks. This is an early-engagement conversation meant to provide clarity and concrete coaching before any formal performance process. Objectives are: clear expectations, measurable signals of progress, and a repeatable check-in cadence.

High-level proposal (suggested):
- Scope: Focus on delivery reliability (on-time task completion), quality (code review back-and-forth), and cross-team communication when priorities shift.
- Success signals: 90% on-time delivery on committed tasks, no high-severity bugs assigned to Rafael in the sprint, improved response time on Slack for triage messages (within 4 hours during working hours).
- Support: Weekly 1:1 with Marissa (manager), focused coaching sessions, and access to an external time-management workshop if helpful.
- Timeline: 6 weeks starting Monday, Oct 4. Interim review at week 3; final review at week 6.

Please see the attached "coaching_template.docx" for a proposed check-in form. Rafael, this is a collaborative plan — we want to hear what you think is missing and what support you need.

Thanks,
Jonas
Director, Product Reliability
Redwood Inference
